scope: Actual Model ObjectStroke setters and native ObjectDrawing route selected Marker3 GLV5/RTV1 and native RedrawPen. Its PenReturnCallback destructor posted a native WorkerTask::Member2<PenDrawableRT, SendDataToGPU>; the explicitly wired host queue ran both native SendData tasks, which populated the same selected RT +88 from the native callback vector after temporary +80 had been cleared. PenGLRenderMsg and vector-delete WorkerTasks were deferred at explicit host boundaries while the same RT executed native Init, native PenGLDataManager::GetPenCanvas/SPGraphicsFactory::CreatePenCanvas, native Update(false), and native Draw to the separately created native RGBA8 target. No vector bytes/points were re-fed and no RT slot was written by the host. Mesa GLES 3.2 llvmpipe provides GL; this is not Android device GPU parity.

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec4 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec2 aPosition; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(aPosition + aRectPoint.xy, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.z, aRectPoint.w); }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; in vec2 fragCoord; uniform vec4 inputColor; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out float FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); FragColor = smoothAlpha * inputColor.a; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec4 position; out vec2 vUV; void main(void) { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); vUV = position.zw; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec2 vUV; uniform sampler2D StrokeTexture; uniform vec4 inputColor; uniform int isOneChannelTexture; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float strokeAlpha = 0.0; if (isOneChannelTexture == 1) strokeAlpha = texture(StrokeTexture, vUV).r; else strokeAlpha = texture(StrokeTexture, vUV).a; if (strokeAlpha > 0.0) FragColor = vec4(inputColor.rgb, strokeAlpha); else discard; }

precision highp float; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; attribute vec3 aVertex; varying float alphaAA; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aVertex.xy, 0.0, 1.0); alphaAA = aVertex.z; }

precision mediump float; varying float alphaAA; uniform vec4 uColor; uniform vec4 uTintColor; uniform int uHasTintColor; void main(void) { float alpha = alphaAA * uColor.a; if (uHasTintColor == 1) { alpha *= uTintColor.a; gl_FragColor = vec4(uTintColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } else { gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } }
